# Akbar Sahata

> Akbar Sahata is a software engineer from Indonesia. Since 2016 he has built backend systems with local and international tech startups, and he is currently a Tech Lead at a multinational enterprise. His work focuses on Node.js and Go, software architecture, cloud infrastructure, and engineering leadership.
